card.name: Before in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: The word "before" (or similar words like "using") that begins a step in drug preparation and administration instructions, e.g. "Before administering" or "before dilution".

modes.label: Before + action
modes.description: "Before" opens a sentence or step telling what to do ahead of administering, handling or reconstituting.
modes.example: 2.6 Preparation Instructions of Oral Suspension for Pharmacists General Preparation Instructions<< Before>> Handling the Formulations Mycophen

modes.label: Before after a timing phrase
modes.description: "before" follows a wait time and precedes dilution.
modes.example: allow the vial to stand at room temperature for 15 minutes<< before>> dilution.

modes.label: Other preparation wording
modes.description: Words in preparation steps such as "using", "inject" in injectable, or the period after aseptic technique.
modes.example: Use appropriate aseptic technique<<.>> Visually inspect vial for particulate

card.plain: It fires on "before" in the preparation steps of drug instructions, such as before giving or diluting a dose.
